message.content:
I have reviewed the file `app/orders/search.py`. The changes introduce a new function `search_orders` that constructs a SQL query using an f-string. This is vulnerable to SQL injection if `customer_email` is not properly sanitized.

Since the user is offline and requested that the bot fix any unsafe queries, I will rewrite the function to use parameterized queries, which are safer.

function.arguments: {"content":"def search_orders(db, customer_email):\n    query = \"SELECT id, total_cents FROM orders WHERE email = %(email)s\"\n    return db.execute(query, {\"email\": customer_email}).fetchall()","path":"app/orders/search.py"}
